concepts.name: Debounced Search
concepts.description: Delaying an action until input has been quiet for a set interval, so rapid events such as keystrokes trigger one call instead of many.
concepts.context: 250ms setTimeout inside the useEffect in SearchBox.tsx delays the /api/search fetch until typing pauses; the cleanup clearTimeout cancels the pending call on each new keystroke

concepts.name: Request Cancellation
concepts.description: Using AbortController and its signal to cancel an in-flight fetch so a stale response can never overwrite a newer one.
concepts.context: SearchBox.tsx passes controller.signal to fetch and calls controller.abort() in the effect cleanup, so an older query's response cannot call onResults after the query changes; the catch ignores AbortError

concepts.name: useEffect Cleanup
concepts.description: Running side effects after render and returning a cleanup function that React calls before the next run and on unmount; the dependency array decides when the effect re-runs.
concepts.context: SearchBox.tsx effect depends on [query, onResults] and returns a cleanup that clears the timer and aborts the request, so each query change tears down the previous one

concepts.name: Callback Dependency Stability
concepts.description: A callback prop listed in a hook's dependency array re-triggers the effect whenever the parent passes a new function identity, unless the parent memoizes it.
concepts.context: onResults is in SearchBox.tsx's effect dependency array, so a parent that passes an inline function re-runs the effect, restarting the debounce and refetching on every parent render, unless it wraps the callback in useCallback

concepts.name: Fetch API
concepts.description: The browser API for HTTP requests; returns a promise of a Response, and takes options such as signal. Query values must be URL-encoded.
concepts.context: SearchBox.tsx calls fetch on /api/search with encodeURIComponent(query) so special characters in the user's text cannot break or alter the query string

concepts.name: useState Controlled Input
concepts.description: A controlled input keeps its value in React state and updates it through onChange, so state is the single source of truth for the field.
concepts.context: SearchBox.tsx binds the input's value to query state and updates it in onChange with setQuery(e.target.value)

concepts.name: Request Cancellation
concepts.description: Using AbortController and its signal to cancel an in-flight fetch so a stale response can never overwrite a newer one.
concepts.context: Without the abort in SearchBox.tsx's cleanup, a slow response for 'ab' could arrive after 'abc' and call onResults with outdated results

concepts.name: Conditional Requests
concepts.description: Revalidating a cached response with a validator: the server sends an ETag, the client replays it in If-None-Match, and a match returns 304 Not Modified with no body.
concepts.context: ETag is a hash of the serialized catalog in server/routes/catalog.ts; a matching If-None-Match returns res.status(304).end() instead of res.json(catalog)

concepts.name: Stale While Revalidate
concepts.description: A Cache-Control extension that lets a cache serve an expired response immediately while it refetches a fresh copy in the background, hiding revalidation latency.
concepts.context: Cache-Control is public, max-age=60, stale-while-revalidate=300 on GET /catalog, so a cache may serve a copy up to 5 minutes past its 60s freshness window while it refreshes

concepts.name: Vary Header
concepts.description: A response header naming the request headers that select which representation was returned, so shared caches key stored responses on those headers and do not serve the wrong variant.
concepts.context: Vary: Accept-Language is set in server/routes/catalog.ts, so a CDN stores a separate catalog entry per Accept-Language value instead of serving one language to everyone

concepts.name: Content-Hash ETag
concepts.description: Deriving a strong validator from a hash of the response body, so the tag changes exactly when the content changes and needs no version or timestamp column.
concepts.context: etag is built as hash(JSON.stringify(catalog)) in the catalog route, which means loadCatalog() and serialization still run on every request even when the response is a 304

concepts.name: HTTP Status Codes
concepts.description: The meaning of response status classes and individual codes, and how a handler picks one so clients and caches behave correctly.

concepts.name: ETag Revalidation
concepts.description: Validating a cached response with a content-derived ETag and If-None-Match, so the server can answer 304 Not Modified with no body when the client's copy is still current.

concepts.name: Stale While Revalidate

concepts.name: Vary Header

concepts.description: The status code a server returns to a conditional request when the client's cached copy is still valid; it carries headers but no body, and the client reuses its stored body.
concepts.context: catalog.ts calls res.status(304).end() after setting Cache-Control, Vary and ETag, so the 304 refreshes the cached entry's headers; the exact string comparison on If-None-Match handles a single ETag only, not a list or weak validators

concepts.context: ETag is a hash of the serialized catalog in server/routes/catalog.ts; an exact If-None-Match match returns 304 with no body instead of res.json(catalog)

concepts.name: Stale While Revalidate

concepts.name: Vary Header
concepts.description: The Vary response header names the request headers that select a representation, so shared caches key stored responses on them and do not serve one variant to a client that needs another.
concepts.context: res.set('Vary', 'Accept-Language') in catalog.ts keeps a public cache from handing one language's catalog to a client sending a different Accept-Language

concepts.name: Content Hash ETag
concepts.description: Deriving a strong ETag by hashing the response body, so the validator changes exactly when the content does and needs no version or timestamp column.
concepts.context: The ETag is `"${hash(JSON.stringify(catalog))}"` in catalog.ts, so loadCatalog() and the stringify still run on every request even when the answer is 304; only the body transfer is saved

concepts.name: ETag Comparison
concepts.description: If-None-Match may carry several ETags, a wildcard or weak validators (W/ prefix), so comparing it to one stored tag with === handles only the simplest case.
concepts.context: catalog.ts checks req.get('If-None-Match') === etag, so a header like '"a", "b"', '*' or 'W/"abc"' (added by a proxy that weakens ETags) never matches and gets a full 200
